hooks.command: INPUT="${CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT:-}"; if echo "$INPUT" | grep -qE 'git commit'; then command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1 && ruff check . || true; fi

INPUT=${CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT:-}; if echo "$INPUT" | grep -qiE 'gh workflow|git push|act |workflow_dispatch'; then   STATUS=$(pgrep -f 'Runner.Listener' > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo online || echo offline);   if [ "$STATUS" = 'offline' ]; then     echo 'WARNING: Self-hosted runner is OFFLINE.';     echo 'Start it first: cd /Users/marcosvasili/actions-runners/hermes-agent && ./run.sh';   fi; fi || true

# GIT_GUARD
INPUT="${CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT:-}"; BLOCK=0; MSG=''; if echo "$INPUT" | grep -qE 'git push.*--force(\s|$)' && ! echo "$INPUT" | grep -q 'force-with-lease'; then BLOCK=1; MSG='BLOCKED: git push --force forbidden. Use --force-with-lease.'; fi; if echo "$INPUT" | grep -qE 'git push.*--force.*\b(main|master)\b'; then BLOCK=1; MSG='BLOCKED: force-push to main/master never allowed.'; fi; if echo "$INPUT" | grep -qE 'git reset --hard' && git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -qE '^(main|master)$'; then BLOCK=1; MSG='BLOCKED: git reset --hard on main/master. Switch branches first.'; fi; if echo "$INPUT" | grep -qE 'git tag -d|git tag.*-f'; then BLOCK=1; MSG='BLOCKED: tag deletion or force-update. Confirm with developer first.'; fi; if [ "$BLOCK" -eq 1 ]; then echo "$MSG"; exit 1; fi; exit 0

# PROTECTED_FILES_GUARD
INPUT="${CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT:-}"; if echo "$INPUT" | grep -qE '"file_path"[^,}]*(\.env(["/]|$)|/\.env"|cli-config\.yaml"|uv\.lock"|package-lock\.json"|flake\.lock"|\.p12"|\.mobileprovision"|\.credentials)'; then echo 'BLOCKED: protected file (env/lockfile/credential/cli-config). Edit the .example, regenerate the lockfile, or confirm with the developer first.'; exit 1; fi; exit 0
